clips.speaker: Yuval Noah Harari
clips.source: Harari x Suleyman, "AI, Consciousness and the Future of Humanity" (2026-11-18)
clips.transcript: My biggest fear is that it's not a specific scenario like AI creating a virus or killer robots.
clips.einordnung: So on the day only machines understand how your world runs, who do you trust? Hear it from him.

clips.speaker: Yuval Noah Harari
clips.source: The Economist, "Yuval Noah Harari on the dangers of an AI future" (2026-08-22)
clips.transcript: And we will not be able to understand it anymore. Just as cows don't understand checks or stocks, even though these things control their lives.
clips.einordnung: Harari looks a step further, to financial products that machines invent themselves.

clips.speaker: Yuval Noah Harari
clips.source: Harari x Suleyman, "AI, Consciousness and the Future of Humanity" (2026-11-18)
clips.transcript: And if we could solve the trust between humans problems, then it will be relatively easy to solve the AI problem.
clips.einordnung: All three are about people. Harari ends up in the same place.
